subject.title: fix(agent): recover gateway runs before fallback

question: Should `openclaw agent` prefer at-most-once recovery and return an explicit in-flight outcome after the recovery deadline, or retain embedded fallback for interactive callers when the original gateway run is still unresolved?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-visible reliability trade-off, not a mechanical correctness choice: preserving fallback favors returning a CLI result, while waiting avoids a second model/tool execution and possible second delivery.

options.title: Approve replay-first for all modes
options.body: Use the proposed authoritative replay path and return the explicit in-flight outcome when a confirmed run remains unresolved at the deadline.

options.title: Use replay-first only where duplicate delivery is most harmful
options.body: Apply the no-recook policy to `--deliver` while retaining the established interactive fallback for stdout-oriented CLI runs.

options.title: Retain recook-first behavior
options.body: Keep embedded fallback as the default after recovery cannot promptly produce a terminal result, accepting the duplicate-execution trade-off.

recommendation.title: Use replay-first only where duplicate delivery is most harmful
recommendation.body: Apply the no-recook policy to `--deliver` while retaining the established interactive fallback for stdout-oriented CLI runs.
